notes.title: GoNNER BLüEBERRY Edition Hotfix Patch Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12155155/9afc55e0c0529544c9d37e7c6a2cde6113d6e111.gif[/img]

Dear blüeberry hoppers,

We've just launched a tiny hotfix patch to fix a number of pesky issues that accompanied the release of BLüEBERRY Edition.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
 - Fixed a launch issue on Linux
 - Fixed an issue where the App file would not always be correctly found on MacOS
 - Fixed an issue where MacOS builds could become corrupted on download

Good luck, and don't lose your head :gonskull::gonheart:

notes.title: BlüeBERRY EdiTION adds new content to GoNNER
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12155155/e5aca4965489cfda0e2591b9f6316da3506dc7b8.jpg[/img]

Out of the blüe, we’ve updated our first IGF award-winning game! GoNNER BlüEBERRY EdiTION add new weapons, heads, enemy types, an new challenge, and some sweet, sweet, new visuals. And yes, there are also blüeberries.

[list]
[*]New head! attack enemies from below!
[*]New weapon! spikes and skull explosions. awe yeah!
[*]New world! Fishes and blueberries!
[*]And a bunch of fine-tunings and stuff!
[*]Some neat new visuals! aw yiss!
[/list]

Hop back into GoNNER if it’s been a while! And if you lose your head, it’s cool—we have plenty more where that came from.

notes.title: Check out Raw Fury's Latest Game!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/yUjyQLs.gif[/img]

We're proud to announce that our latest game, Tormentor❌Punisher, is now released!

Warning: this game features profane language, insane difficulty and an [b]awesome[/b] launch trailer. 

Enjoy!


[img]http://i.imgur.com/iP9rUOL.gif[/img]

[h1]Welcome to Planet Fuck You![/h1]

Everything in Tormentor❌Punisher can be killed in one hit, including bosses and yourself. Bosses change the shape of the arena, conjuring rooms and traps to make it more hellish and brutal. 

Explore and discover new ways of killing enemies to gain cool upgrades that have great names like "Hot Stuff" and "Fuck You," and other terms just bursting with friendliness. Reload your machine gun by firing your shotgun. Yeah, you read that right.

All of this is in the name of leaderboards and bragging to strangers on the internet about how much better you are than them at video games. There is local co-op in the game, too! Grab a controller and a friend to wreck demon ass. 

[i]PAX East Booth 2017:[/i]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HFMcX37.gif[/img]


[h1]Want to learn more about the game? Here are some great videos to get you started:[/h1]

[url=https://youtu.be/-mcPKcOdIfk]Launch Trailer:[/url]
[url=https://youtu.be/-mcPKcOdIfk][img]http://i.imgur.com/faaLQS7.gif[/img][/url]

[url=https://youtu.be/dRDjgf3DMDE]The Most Metal Tutorial Video Ever:[/url]
[url=https://youtu.be/dRDjgf3DMDE][img]http://i.imgur.com/uicJZQf.gif[/img][/url]

We hope you enjoy your time on Planet Fuck You. See you in the leaderboards... Right? ☠

[b]LET'S FUCKING DO THIS![/b]

[b]BUY NOW:[/b]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/500670

notes.title: MERRY HOLIDAYS!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12155155/82360314a36e7a13a68592004f13450d7e518c71.gif[/img]

Happy holidays or whatever one says this time of year!! 

This update is a week late, but it's just in time for the holidays! This week I wanted to concentrate on polish and fine tuning, so this week's update is subtle but important! 
[list]
[*] The Shotgun got a tune up. It now fires a more concentrated burst of bullets.
[*] Some various minor visual changes / tune ups. 
[*] Fixed a bug some players experienced where they were dying after beating the game. (sorry!)
[*] General optimizations to a lot of effects and how particles get generated. 
[/list]
I'm not much for holiday celebrations, but I will indeed enjoy some free time to play a bunch of video games and hang around with loved ones. 

Take care <3
//
Ditto

notes.title: Stop right there!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12155155/5d1951af023e62b7a9df8b9d66435b217e362d0e.gif[/img]

OH SNAP! UPDATE TIME! 

This weeks update contains a handful of nice little fixes and tweaks. But most of all it contains my new favorite backpack, the time stopper! If you want to find it, you'll have to [spoiler]search the ceiling, but be quick about it![/spoiler]

[list]
[*] Hedgehogs can now be hurt a few frames after they start hiding. 
[*] Enemies you kill will always update the combo counter now. Even if they don't award points. 
[*] You can now see items you haven't unlocked yet, in Deaths lair!
[*] Fixed a bug that could soft lock the tutorial levels. 
[*] There's a handful more enemies in [spoiler]Robot Kings level[/spoiler] now! 
[*] TIME STOPPER BACKPACK! 
[*] I changed how gamepads are identified. Hopefully fixing issues some players had with gamepads not being found by the game.  
[/list]

And finally.. This week saw 2 players compete like crazy people over the top score. Horheristo and Spleen are both over 100k. 100.000 points. ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND POINTS! WHAT? YES! HOLY POOPSICLES! Congrats to both of you! 

<3
Ditto

notes.title: Two new heads!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12155155/c8141221711a101ae93649522188aec4af6dedb7.gif[/img]
OH SHI- NEW HEADS? WOAH! 

Black Friday is coming up, and to celebrate consumerism we've added two new heads to GoNNER!! They're hidden pretty well though, so you'll have to search carefully! 

I've also added VSync to the graphics options, hoping the game will run a bit smoother for more people now! 

[list]
[*] VSync! Woah! SMOOTH FPS INCOMING??? 
[*] Invisible ceiling to open levels. No more flying forever. 
[*][spoiler]Pyramid[/spoiler] head: [spoiler]shorter backpack cooldowns! NICE![/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Heavy[/spoiler] head: [spoiler]... makes you heavy. Removes pushback from guns and deals more damage when jumping on enemies.[/spoiler]
[/list]

Finding the new heads are going to be pretty tricky. Here's a hint for one of them: 
[spoiler] Somewhere in a bright place unless you died already. [/spoiler]

BONUS: GoNNER is on sale this week too as part of Steam's Black Friday sale. Get the game for 20% off! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/437570

notes.title: More Ghost Friends!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12155155/434c3b3e979564af6eb014cefcc3722b7571c54a.gif[/img]

WHAT'S UP! 

It's Friday! Let's update GoNNER? YEAH! oKAY! CooL! CAPSLoCK! HAHA!

I'm super excited about this update, there's a lot of cool new stuff! I've recently started experimenting with some super professional shaders and stuff. I didn't want to go overboard, so the changes are pretty subtle but it turned out super smooth! Hope you like it! 

On top of that, there's now friendly ghosts! They're really helpful. There are 3 different ones in total, but you can only have one ghost following you at a time. How you find them I'll leave up to you! :) 

LIST TIME! 

[list]
[*] ANTI EFFING ALIASING (also known simply as AA, lol) 
[*] BLOOM 
[*] "CONTRAST ENHANCEMENT"
[*] [spoiler]Gear ghost: picks your gear back up so you won't have to![/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Gun ghost: helps you shoot stuff PEW PEW [/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Glyph ghost: picks up glyphs for you. Really, who has time for that stuff, right? [/spoiler]
[/list]

Hint to get a ghost friend: 
[spoiler] Sometimes when you're hurt, the best thing you can do is hug a friend <3 [/spoiler]

notes.title: Gear updated: Ghosts!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12155155/697f05dcc43a71c73e7e62e0c82b8924e170e79c.gif[/img]

Hey yo whaddup people! 

There's a new update for the game! I try to upload a new update every week by the way! WOAH! 

This week I've added a little something to the daily challenge, a friendly [spoiler]fairy-ghost-spirit-thingy[/spoiler]! It'll help you [spoiler]keep track [/spoiler]of your [spoiler]gear[/spoiler]! Sweet! In a future update these will pop up in the main game, there's even going to be different kinds with different abilities! But until everything works as intended you can at least get a first feel for it in the Daily. 

Apart from that this week's got a bunch of nice polish and balance: 

[list]
[*]There's an extra tutorial level in the "intro", and you can now play the intro from the main menu! 
[*]Camera mode, available in the gameplay options! If you dislike the camera, you can make it stop trying to be fancy now! NICE! 
[*]A minor fix to input handling. Hopefully more devices should work now! 
[*]A fancy controls display in the splash screen! 
[*]Sharkfin now gets deactivated when jumping through a World Snake.
[*]Grey [spoiler]Bopskulls (the skull enemies in Death World that get grey if you kill enough of them.)[/spoiler] no longer award combo.
[/list]

That's it for this week, next week I hope to have the [spoiler]Fairy Merchant[/spoiler] in the main game!! Keep your eyes peeled! 

<3

Ditto
